<!DOCTYPE html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width">
<title>Verificação de segurança — Senado Federal</title>
<style>
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { background: #f1f1f1; color: #222; margin: 0; padding: 0; min-height: 100vh; font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; }

  .sf-header { background: #00315c; padding: 16px 24px; }
  .sf-header svg { display: block; height: 23px; width: auto; }
  .sf-stripe-green { height: 4px; width: 100%; background: #00824a; }
  .sf-stripe-yellow { height: 4px; width: 100%; background: #fae042; }

  main.sf-main { min-height: calc(100vh - 31px - 46px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 40px 20px; }

  #progress {
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
    padding: 40px 36px;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 420px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .sf-state { display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 22px; }
  .sf-state.active { display: flex; }

  .sf-spinner { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid #cef1fc; border-top-color: #0095da; animation: spin 1.1s linear infinite; }
  .sf-check { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; background: #00824a; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  .sf-error-icon { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; background: #cf4840; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; }

  .sf-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #00315c; }
  .sf-sub { font-size: 15px; color: #666; line-height: 1.5; }
  .sf-error .sf-title { color: #ad443d; }

  @keyframes spin {
    to { transform:rotate(360deg); }
  }

  .sf-footer { position: fixed; bottom: 0; width: 100%; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: #999; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid #e5e5e5; background: #fff; }

  iframe { display: none; }
</style>
